name: Shaad Qureshi
title: Gameplay/Engine Programmer
summary: I'm a game developer with a strong computer science background, specializing in implementing core gameplay mechanics with Unity and Unreal Engine. My passion is creating engaging worlds that captivate players and inspire new creators.
about: I am a Computer Science student with a proficiency in AI, but I'm a passionate game developer at heart. My love for unique worlds and storytelling began with a Nintendo Wii in my childhood. I specialize in implementing core gameplay mechanics, using my C# skills in Unity and Blueprint expertise in Unreal Engine to bring creative visions to life. Through freelance projects, I've enjoyed collaborating with designers, offering technical solutions to realize their complex concepts. My ultimate ambition is to contribute to the development of beloved games at major studios and one day create my own, inspiring the next generation of gamers.

projects.title: Counting Sheep
projects.desc: A 3D arcade platformer built for the GMTK Game Jam 2026. Players guide a floaty sheep across voxel cloud-numerals that crumble and reform underneath them as the sleeper counts down to sleep.

projects.title: Harvest Rush
projects.desc: A fast-paced couch co-op and solo farming game where players till soil, sow seeds, water crops, and rush harvested produce to a scheduled delivery truck while defending the farm from hungry pests and spreading fires.

projects.title: Pokémon Bushido
projects.desc: Pokémon Bushido is a fan-made game set in a feudal Japan-inspired region, where players train Pokémon to become a Kenshi, battling rival clans and dark forces in a unique samurai-themed adventure.

projects.title: Pokémon Splice
projects.desc: Pokémon Splice is a fan-made game where you're a research assistant helping Professor Cypress discover new Pokémon forms, featuring a unique, type-changing starter and a branching story.

projects.title: CareerPath AI
projects.desc: An AI-assisted development experiment built in 3 days with Gemini 3 Pro. This AI counselor generates hyper-personalized career roadmaps and realistic 'day-in-the-life' visualizations to help users find their ideal career.

projects.title: SQLift
projects.desc: SQLift is a full-stack workout tracking web application with a rich relational database at its core. Users can plan custom workouts, track live sessions set-by-set, monitor body measurements and analytics over time, and compete on global and friend leaderboards.

projects.title: NanoRewind 4K
projects.desc: A web app that restores old, scratched, and blurry photos to 4K using Google Gemini. Results can be rendered in six photographic developer styles, and a drag slider compares the restoration against the original.

projects.title: Artist Portfolio
projects.desc: A portfolio website for Emaad, an artist in my family, built with React and Vite and hosted free on GitHub Pages. Emaad adds and edits pieces through a Decap CMS dashboard without writing any code.

projects.title: HOMI - Helpful Online Mentor Interface
projects.desc: An AI-powered learning assistant for IT students, using LLMs to offer personalized study material, real-time query resolution, automated test generation, and attendance and assignment tracking.

projects.title: Findly - Lost and Found Application
projects.desc: An Android application with a Firebase-powered backend, which acts as a platform to list lost or found items and chat with users to recover lost items or return found ones.
